content.comment_body: Hello all, I need to program a new [product_name] device for a customer after a previous unit suffered water damage, using a VPN connection. The customer already set IP subnet and gateway on the [product_name] menu, and I can ping the device, but I'm unable to download the program. [product_name] Soft Comfort recognizes the hardware, prompts for the password (I used the default), but the download doesn't start. The system says I need a newer program version, however I'm running the latest update ([version_no]). With this same VPN, I can access other hardware and HMIs at the site without problem, so I suspect this is a [product_name] Soft Comfort bug.
You should consider submitting a support request for further assistance.
It's possible the problem relates to a mismatch between the [product_name] hardware you've selected in the project and what's actually installed. Make sure both are the same hardware version.
If that was the case, the system wouldn't prompt for a password.
Prompting for a password can be caused by several things: an incorrect IP address, no IP entered in the field, or connection issues.

I've experienced this before; when connecting over WiFi the [product_name] asks for a password. If I connect the same device directly via Ethernet cable, it doesn't prompt for a password. Am I missing something here?

Last week, I encountered exactly the same error while downloading a program at a customer's site. In my situation, I had selected the wrong network adapter in the interface settings (it was set to a virtual machine adapter instead of the physical one, see screenshot). Despite this, the test connection gave me a green check and asked for a password. After entering it, I received the message to upgrade to a newer version. While I'm not sure whether this is your exact issue, there are similarities.

For me, downloading succeeded only after entering the password via WiFi. It's not a pure connection problem, but changing the network adapter caused the device to ask for a password. This happens with all [product_name] connections over WiFi for download or upload.

analysis.insight_summary: Several users report difficulties programming [product_name] devices via VPN, specifically when using [product_name] Soft Comfort. The main issue is that downloads to the newly installed hardware are blocked with messages requesting password entry and/or program version upgrades, even when the latest software is installed. The issue seems connected either to network adapter selection, device version compatibility, or how connections are configured over WiFi versus wired, rather than a general VPN or connectivity problem.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to remotely download and program [product_name] hardware using the current [product_name] Soft Comfort, without running into software version or connection troubles.
